thread:
Aisha: quick heads-up — bringing up parallax-14b in staging. Need a short runtime compatibility probe focused on RoPE behavior, KV cache alignment, and q4/q8 quantization effects. Goal: determine whether it runs on our current 80G pools or needs kernel patches.

Tom: sg. can you drop the HF link + model config? also which runtime version are we testing against? v2.3 had a rotary change.

Aisha: link: https://huggingface.co/parallax/parallax-14b v1.0. testing against runtime v2.4-rc. config snippet: 
```json
{"hidden_size":12288, "num_heads": 96, "rope":"2d", "kv_layout":"packed", "embed_dim":12288}
```

Riley: quick notes — try both --rotary-mode=standard and --rotary-mode=alt. watch for off-by-one in kvcache offsets when using packed layout.

Priya: I can reserve staging infra for a 30m slot. tag me when jobs are created.

Tom: proposed checklist:
1) model load smoke: instantiate, run a single forward, ensure no kernel fallback logs.
2) attention sanity: run identical input twice with caching enabled to confirm KV replay matches.
3) long-context drift: push sequences to 8k and scan attention norms for drifting magnitudes.
4) quant smoke: q8 static quantize, run eval set (small perplexity + semantic checks) vs fp32.
5) perf run: 1000 requests at batch sizes 1/4/8 to measure p50/p95.

Aisha: adding customer constraint: doris team needs <80ms p95 for 128-token gen. If we can't hit that, they want fallback smaller model. :thinking_face:

Riley: also: when testing q8, compare token-level logits top-5 divergence and run a 10-prompt hallucination checklist. aggressive quant can cause subtle LM drift.

DevBot: deploy job created — job/1719954321-parallax-compat-check (staging) by Tom :white_check_mark:

Priya: reserved staging GPU slot 2024-07-15T09:30Z -> 09:50Z for this run.

Tom: assigned: @Riley kernel/rotary smoke, @Priya infra/reserve, @Aisha eval prompts + hf link, @Tom quant + perf. ETA: tomorrow EOD.

Aisha: I'll upload 10 eval prompts and expected outputs here right after this thread. Thanks all :raised_hands:
